ReportTransformationView

Report transformations allow you to modify the presentation and organization of data in your reports without affecting the underlying accounting records.

From this view, you can examine the details of a specific report transformation, including its configuration settings and the results it produces when applied to reports.

Use the information displayed here to verify that your transformation is working as intended and producing the desired output in your financial reports.

To create or edit report transformations, see: Report Transformation
